newsitem.title: USA: Jacor gets $247.1 mln from offerings.
newsitem.headline: Jacor gets $247.1 mln from offerings.

text.p: Jacor Communications Inc said it had raised $247.1 million in net proceeds from two recent stock offerings.
Jacor, which radio and television stations, said it had sold 7.6 million shares of common stock to the public, including an over-allotment of 997,500 shares.
It said it also sold 673,628 shares to an affiliate of its largest shareholder, Zell/Chilmark Fund LP, in a separate closing.
Total shares outstanding excluding pending transactions total 43.2 million, it said.
Jacor's stock was trading at 34-1/8 on the Nasdaq Stock Market early Thursday, down 1/8 from the previous day's close.
